purpose: Prospective confirmation of spatial-residual outage resilience on a sensor network not used in model development.

dataset.name: US EPA AQS Salt Lake County hourly sensor network
dataset.license_or_terms: US EPA public monitoring data; preserve source attribution and retrieval metadata
dataset.time_zone: America/Denver; AQS local and GMT timestamps will both be retained and DST duplicates/gaps audited on development data
dataset.station_selection_rule: Intersection of Salt Lake County sites with at least 50% annual observation coverage for PM2.5, NO2, and O3 in every development year 2021-2024; selection made without 2025 data.
dataset.target_policy: Evaluate every prespecified station-pollutant cell with valid observed targets; report common-core and partial-pollutant strata separately as well as the prespecified masked macro.

split_policy.test: 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31 local time; sealed and untouched until final protocol freeze
split_policy.test_access_rule: No test metrics, plots, examples, or aggregate summaries may be viewed until code, hyperparameters, hypotheses, and calibration are frozen.

forecast.target_pollutants: intersection of prespecified pollutant set and verified dataset variables

fairness_constraints: same forecast origins and observed targets
same input variables and availability unless the model definition requires a documented graph
same probabilistic objective and validation selection rule
same training budget and early-stopping rule

statistical_plan.pairing: aligned forecast origins within dataset, station, pollutant, horizon, condition, and seed
statistical_plan.temporal_dependence: paired moving-block procedure with block length locked before test
statistical_plan.multiplicity: Holm correction over the prespecified primary comparison family
statistical_plan.seed_interpretation: optimization variability only; not independent geographic replication

reporting_rule: Report all prespecified primary and guardrail outcomes regardless of direction. Do not select the final architecture, distribution, threshold, calibration method, or comparator after viewing test results.
